title: ErrorResponse
description: The only failure shape in the contract. Every non-2xx HTTP response body is an ErrorResponse. No endpoint defines its own error shape.

ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode
ErrorCode.description: Fixed set of failure codes. HTTP status per code: invalid_input 400, unauthorized 401, not_found 404, conflict 409, internal 500, device_unavailable 503, degraded 503, device_timeout 504. Clients branch on the code, never on the message.

message.description: One English sentence for logs and toasts. Never parsed by clients.

detail.description: Machine readable context, an empty object when there is none. Conventional keys: invalid_input uses field and reason, not_found uses resource and id, conflict uses resource and conflicting_id, device_unavailable uses device, reason and last_seen_at, device_timeout uses device, cmd_id and attempts, degraded uses components.
